up-sqlite3: parts, licences and where the source is

Part     Licence                           Source
-------  --------------------------------  -------------------
sqlite   Public domain (licenses/sqlite)   upterm-ports (pkgs/sqlite)

Notes
- The complete source with UP-Term's patches and build recipes is up-term-src.lha, published next to
  up-term.lha. Its row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/sqlite/SOURCES.txt.
